$comment: Copy to ~/.pi/agent/geocine.json and edit. Project override: .pi/geocine.json (consultants merge by name).

frontier.$comment: OAuth providers (pi /login, stored in ~/.pi/agent/auth.json) need no envKeys: consultant children are pi processes on the host and inherit auth. envKeys are only for API-key providers inside the docker jail.
frontier.role: hard debugging, root-cause analysis, and planning complex changes

local-big.role: second opinion that costs nothing; quick sanity checks and code review

abliterated.role: content strict models falsely refuse: reverse engineering, security analysis, decompiled binaries
abliterated.notes: Fallback consultant for content that strict cloud models falsely refuse (reverse engineering, security analysis, decompiled binaries).

approval.$comment: Gate for LLM-invoked consult tool calls (user-typed /consult never asks). 'ask' prompts yes/no/always-allow/auto-all; 'auto' never prompts. Per-consultant: "autoApprove": true.

watchdog.$comment_baseUrl: Optional tier-1 LLM watchdog. Use a SECOND small model instance (e.g. Qwen 4B on another port), never the main single-slot server — a side request there evicts the main KV cache.

context.$comment: context-keeper: checkpoint = structured prefix-cache-aligned compaction summary (summarizer defaults to the session model — free on a warm local KV cache; set to a consultant name to use that model). pruner = deterministic head/tail trim of OLD oversized tool results before each request (session log keeps the full output). recall = transcript-search tool so compaction is never lossy.

rescue.$comment: Captures manual local->frontier /model switches as rescue episodes in the consult-log. /distill drafts a lesson from the last episode using distillConsultant (default: prescreen.consultant).
